basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 31-year-old gamer based in Madison, Wisconsin. I recently got into League of Legends, and I've been playing as a mid/jungle main, focusing on champions like Orianna, Nunu, Vi, and Skarner. Outside of gaming, I'm exploring the local dining scene and enjoy weekend road trips to Michigan. I'm single and usually online during the late evenings after my shift at a local tech support job. I'm also part of the LGBTQ+ community and enjoy connecting with others who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a self-taught gamer, I've been learning the ins and outs of League of Legends through YouTube tutorials and Twitch streams. My tech support job has given me a good grasp of basic technology troubleshooting, which sometimes helps with optimizing my gaming setup.
